links.outcome: Classifier robustness to simulated segmentation errors (erosion, dilation, closing) in cartilage masks
links.effect: Linear and RBF SVC and Logistic Regression under error-modified datasets: F1 0.80-0.86, ROC AUC 0.86-0.92; tree-based models more sensitive to dilation errors, most models kept weighted F1 ≥ 0.75.
links.quote: While tree-based models were more sensitive to dilation errors, most models maintained weighted F1 scores ≥ 0.75.

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the robustness and safety/reliability of downstream ML classifiers when subjected to simulated automated and manual input segmentation errors.

primary.practice: robustness testing under simulated segmentation error
